subject: Inbound demo booking — cross-region IT checklist & availability
messages:
From: no-reply@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-24T09:12:00Z
Subject: New trial signup: Globex Systems — Request demo

Lead info:
- Company: Globex Systems
- Contact: Aidan Murphy (aidan.murphy@globex.com)
- Role: Product Manager
- Notes: Signed up for 14-day trial, checked box: 'Interested in a walkthrough + IT/security Q&A'
- Preferred times: Weekdays afternoons CET

Suggested next step: SDR outreach to schedule multi-stakeholder demo (AE + SE + IT).

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: aidan.murphy@globex.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-24T11:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo to get you started (AE + SE + IT)

Hi Aidan — congrats on starting the trial and thanks for the note. I’m Grace (SDR) on the Redwood side — happy to coordinate a short walkthrough.

To make sure we cover what’s important for you, can you confirm which stakeholders will join? You mentioned IT/security — if you can loop Simone (IT) and Paul (CISO) that’d be great.

Proposed 30–45 minute windows (all CET/CEST):
- Tue Apr 27, 15:00–15:45 CET (14:00–14:45 UTC)
- Wed Apr 28, 10:00–10:45 CET (09:00–09:45 UTC)
- Thu Apr 29, 16:00–16:45 CET (15:00–15:45 UTC)

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll lock AE + SE in. We’ll bring product + infra detail and a short IT checklist so your team can validate network/KMS requirements ahead of time.

Quick ask: are there any firm constraints (VPN-only, specific firewall egress, or recording restrictions)?

Thanks,
Grace O
SDR, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

From: Aidan Murphy <aidan.murphy@globex.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: Simone Brunetti <simone.brunetti@globex.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T11:32:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo to get you started (AE + SE + IT)

Hi Grace — thanks, and nice to meet you. I looped Simone (IT) and will add Paul (CISO) if he can make it.

Our availability (CEST):
- Wed Apr 28, 09:30–10:30 CEST (works best)
- Thu Apr 29, 16:00–17:00 CEST (backup)

A few notes from IT/security:
- We need a short pre-demo checklist (network ports, outbound IPs, SAML/KMS options).
- Is Redwood SOC 2 Type II? We’ll want that on file prior to any POC with production data.
- We prefer the meeting over Zoom but please share the recording only with named attendees.

If you can propose a slot that includes AE + SE, Simone will block time.

Best,
Aidan
Product Manager, Globex Systems
aidan.murphy@globex.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: aidan.murphy@globex.com, simone.brunetti@globex.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-24T13:10:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo to get you started (AE + SE + IT)

Hi Aidan / Simone — thanks for the quick reply. I’m Karthik (AE) and I’ll run the product portion; Mateo (SE) will cover infra and the KMS/network questions.

We can do Wed Apr 28 at 09:30 CEST. Mateo — can you be available to cover the POC network/KMS checklist and a short architecture slide (10m)?

Quick agenda (30–40m):
1) 10m — product walkthrough (AE)
2) 10–12m — infra & security deep-dive (SE)
3) 5–10m — Q&A and next steps / mutual action plan

Attached is a short IT checklist we typically share ahead of demos (redwood-it-checklist.pdf). Simone — would you confirm any additional constraints (VPN-only access, egress IP blocks) and whether Paul should be looped explicitly?

Zoom is fine — we’ll send a calendar invite with recording disabled by default; recording can be enabled on request.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kar t h i k_ i y e r@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Attachment: redwood-it-checklist.pdf (1 page, checklist of ports, SAML/KMS notes, recommended client settings)

From: Simone Brunetti <simone.brunetti@globex.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aidan.murphy@globex.com, paul.harris@globex.com
Date: 2027-04-24T15:04:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo to get you started (AE + SE + IT)

Karthik — thanks for the checklist, that helps. A few follow-ups before we lock the slot (we prefer to have answers up front so the meeting stays focused):
- Can you share a short network diagram or list of outbound IP ranges we should whitelist?
- Confirmed: we require SOC 2 Type II evidence. Who on your side can share the report or the auditor contact?
- For KMS: does Redwood support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for the Dedicated/Private options? Any one-pager on encryption-at-rest would be useful.

If you can drop those three items in an email before Wed 09:30 CEST, we’ll confirm attendance and I’ll ask Paul to join for the tail end of the call. Also prefer the meeting not be recorded unless we agree during the call.

Best,
Simone Brunetti
Head of Infrastructure, Globex Systems
simone.brunetti@globex.com
